interpretation: The task-matched shear chart generalizes in sign: it lowers finite CE relative to fresh88 on all four untouched validation windows, and dense exact beats fresh88 on all four.
The magnitude is insufficient under the preregistered rule. It recovers only 3.82-9.12% of the dense-over-fresh gap, with 6.78% median, below the fixed 5% worst-window and 10% median thresholds.

The prior fit gate recovered 6.08% more dense-update Frobenius energy than fresh88 in every layer, but that weight-space gain becomes only a small CE gain. The remaining bottleneck is therefore activation/task metric alignment, not missing symmetric-shear capacity or numerical conditioning.
The threshold is not weakened after observation. fresh64_shear24 is not authorized for production integration, MFU preflight, training, or a larger rung.

The next admissible zero-update test should keep the same coordinate budget but select and fit shear pairs using the post-GELU-and-c_proj functional metric on a train-only fit window, then score on new untouched validation windows.

authorization.next_action: Preregister a fit-only functional-metric shear gate that compares weight-space pair selection with post-GELU/c_proj activation-weighted pair selection at the same 135,168 coordinates.
